Game Overview

At its heart, Adventure To The Candy Princes is a two-player game about venture with a friend through the whimsical Candy Forest to free the Sugar Princess in this cooperative adventure. Master double jumps, gather candies to unlock portals, and dodge formidable foes. Dive into enchanting landscapes filled with strategic puzzles and thrilling challenges on your sweet quest to the Ice Kingdom.
